sources.title: Paper2Agent: Reimagining Papers As AI Agents - GitHub
sources.snippet: Paper2Agent is a multi-agent AI system that automatically transforms research papers into interactive AI agents with minimal human input. Explore demos of Paper2Agent-generated agents, or try it yourself at paper2agent.ai. Paper2Agent coordinates parallel specialist agents to turn scientific papers into reliable MCP servers and skills.
